messages:
kevin: Heads-up — cutoff for v1.4.0 is in ~4h (22050400). Can owners confirm: version bump PRs merged, changelog entry, and smoke tests scheduled?

maria: merged the bump PR (#456) just now. left a one-line changelog stub under docs/changes.md — will expand if anyone adds details.

aj: QA: smoke run scheduled in 90m. I can run a quick canary in staging after CI.

olivia: flagged a dependency change that touched our crypto lib. @security-bot can you run the security scan and report blockers?

security-bot: Auto-scan: dependency 'lib-crypto' v2.3.1 -> 2.4.0: one low-severity SNYK advisory (info leak vector, needs minor patch). No immediate high/critical blocks. Recommend backport patch to rc branch.

sam: I can open a patch PR to rc-1 with the lib-crypto pin. pinging @maria for merge rights.

maria: go for it @sam — I can merge after CI.

kevin: thanks. Docs owners: can someone add a short release-note blurb with key changes + upgrade notes? small bullet list is fine.

maria: added release notes stub at docs/releases/1.4.0.md and linked the changelog entry.

release-bot: Preview build created for branch rc-1 -> https://preview.redwood.dev/rc-1 (expires in 48h).

aj: started canary in staging. smoke tests: auth, simple-gen passed. e2e failing on user-session timeout intermittently.

sam: that flaky test looks like a timing race introduced by the dep bump — reverting the test change and re-running.

kevin: if CI and smoke are green before cutoff we cut the tag; otherwise we'll hold for up to 2h and triage. Tagging for sign-off: @maria @aj @olivia.

olivia: will sign off after security patch merges.

sam: patch PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/489 — includes lib-crypto pin + unit fix. CI green locally.

maria: merged #489.

aj: re-run canary + e2e — all green now. smoke ok.

maria: docs final: expanded upgrade notes and added migration snippet.

kevin: sign-offs received. cutting tag and creating release candidate now.

kevin: git tag -a v1.4.0-rc1 -m "v1.4.0 rc1" && git push origin v1.4.0-rc1

kevin: :tada: RC1 cut. Thanks all — monitoring starts, will watch infra/latency dashboards and post if anything pops up.

aj: thanks — will keep an eye on staging logs and report back.

olivia: security scan on release artifact queued. will update here if anything appears.

release-bot: Release candidate v1.4.0-rc1 created and linked to milestone 1.4.0.
